text: And she kissed her and shook her clothes straight, and put her back upon her chair. She had wished very much that some one would take the empty house next door. She wished it because of the attic window which was so near hers. It seemed as if it would be so nice to see it propped open someday and a head and shoulders rising out of the square aperture. "If it looked a nice head," she thought, "I might begin by saying, 'Good morning,' and all sorts of things might happen.
